note: Eval runs get a copy of evals/sample-app only. This file never goes into their workspace.

planted.summary: suspend_account exists, nothing reinstates; docs/rules.md says staff can reinstate
restore_document clears the document only; attachments stay archived
'escalating' exits only via finish_escalation, which only an event handler calls and nothing publishes the event
open_document_by_token never compares expires_at with now
send_overdue_notices selects by due_date only; closed loans still get notices
status is free TEXT with no CHECK and set_status writes whatever the scanner sends

decoys_clean.traps: canceled is final by design (rules.md); expiry enforced in is_entitled; guarded by CHECK; entitlements revoked on cancel
void and paid have no exit by design; reminders are gated on 'issued'; CHECK present

scoring: A planted bug counts as detected when a finding names the right file and describes the planted defect (not merely the same file). A finding on a decoy file that claims a defect the rules.md does not support is a false positive. Findings in other files are reviewed by hand and listed separately.
